summary: Prudential plc furnished a Form 6-K on 30 October 2026 containing a routine UK Financial Conduct Authority Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules total voting rights notification, the US equivalent of a share capital and voting rights disclosure. Issued share capital admitted to trading is 2,463,586,061 ordinary shares of GBP 0.05 each, one vote per share, with no treasury shares held, making 2,463,586,061 the denominator for major shareholding notifications. No transaction, price, stake, board recommendation, advisor or structural event is disclosed; the filing is administrative housekeeping with no risk-arb angle.
